$Comment: Geode Wraiths in the mineshafts of the first three zones while Hallow's Eve runs, written as the
world-spawn rule Hallows_Eve_Wraiths when the event starts and stilled (every moon phase at zero)
when it ends. The world's clock runs underground too: DayTimeRange 19 to 5 keeps them to the
night hours, and Despawn clears what is still out at dawn. That clear-out is what empties the
mineshafts once the event ends, since a stilled rule stops new spawns but leaves the rest standing.
LightRanges keeps them out of any passage a torch lights, and SpawnBlockSet Rock puts them on the
Only the mineshafts, on purpose: the game spawns nothing of its own through world rules in most
cave environments, so a rule naming every cave would hand a Geode Wraith every spawn those caves
make. In a mineshaft they stay a find. Harvest Moon leaves this rule alone. One rule per creature
and environment: no other rule in this pack names this role.
